title: Answer: pre-registered mechanical verdicts would change the framework

statements.text: The framework is changed by tests registered before the data: a falsified compulsory prediction, or an arena that splits the shared parameter. The 2026 rebuild also withdrew several of its own earlier claims after finding errors in them.

sources.quote: Each arena includes a pre-registered decision rule so that confirmation or refutation is mechanical rather than rhetorical.
A null can falsify only a compulsory prediction.
